user.title: Weather station
user.description: Select your weather station sensors. Only temperature and humidity (or dew point) are required; more sensors give a more precise score.

data_description.humidity: Humidity or dew point is required; the other is calculated.
data_description.vpd: Optional. Without it, VPD is calculated from temperature and humidity.
data_description.rain_hourly: Stops the score when more rain fell in the last hour than the set limit.

forecast.title: Weather forecast
forecast.description: Select weather entities for the hourly forecast. With two sources they are merged per hour.

data_description.forecast_primary: This source wins per hour, e.g. KNMI.
data_description.forecast_secondary: Fills missing fields (such as humidity) and later hours, e.g. Met.no.

error.need_humidity: Select a humidity or dew point sensor.
error.order_spread: The 2-point limit must be at least the 1-point limit.
error.order_day: Start hour must be before end hour.

thresholds.title: Thresholds and times
thresholds.description: Points: VPD max 3, dew point spread max 2, wind max 2, sun max 1. A stop factor sets the score to 0.
